activity_statements.statement: develops and markets transformative prescription medicines in oncology, neurology, cardiovascular/metabolic diseases, ophthalmology, infectious diseases, and immunology for patients in 100+ countries
manufactures and sells in-vitro diagnostics including laboratory instruments, reagents, point-of-care tests, and digital pathology tools as the world's largest IVD provider
conducts R&D across biotechnology and molecular biology to discover and develop medicines and diagnostic solutions, with 125+ years of innovation history
develops AI-enabled clinical decision support tools including algorithms that predict nighttime hypoglycemia up to 7 hours in advance for diabetes patients, achieving a 31% reduction in severe events
operates Roche Diagnostics as a separate division providing automated lab systems, blood glucose monitors, and molecular testing platforms to hospitals and clinical labs
expands healthcare access globally through philanthropic programs and access-to-medicine initiatives in low- and middle-income countries

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Biotechnology Research' captures only the pharma/research side; Roche is equally the world's largest manufacturer and distributor of in-vitro diagnostic instruments and reagents — a large-scale physical-product hardware and consumables business invisible behind the biotech label.
extraction_notes: Roche about page provided strong operational content covering both divisions. Segment revenue weight (72/28 pharma/diagnostics) is consistent with Roche's historically reported division split. AI diagnostics detail came directly from the about page case study.
